items.title: Stakeholder perspectives on the role of economic evidence in decision-making for diabetes-related foot ulcer treatments
items.summary: Dear Editor, Diabetes-related foot ulcers (DFUs) represent a major clinical and economic burden for patients and healthcare systems (Armstrong et al, 2017; Kerr et al, 2019; Edmonds et al, 2021). Economic evaluations are increasingly encouraged to inform adoption and reimbursement decisions for DFU interventions.
